Ram Temple Donation Allegations Spark Probes and Public Scrutiny

Allegations of theft and irregularities concerning donations to the Ram Temple in Ayodhya have surfaced, leading to official probes and public discussion. Reports indicate an SBI manager questioned in the case was a tenant of a temple trustee, while other allegations involve missing gold ornaments. The controversy has prompted a response from the RSS and has drawn parallels to similar donation allegations at the Badrinath Temple.
